title: Preference-Based Estimation of Achievement Scalarising Function Parameters via Ordinal Regression
summary: Estimating the parameters of an achievement scalarising function is a challenging task in multiobjective optimisation. Achievement scalarising functions are widely used in several contexts, including preference-based optimisation methods and algorithmic procedures for generating or selecting efficient solutions. However, their effectiveness strongly depends on the appropriate specification of their parameters, such as weights and reference points.
